user_stories.title: Fix DAIN input dimension mismatch in CausalLOBForecaster
user_stories.description: Update the feature splitting logic in CausalLOBForecaster to correctly assign 26 features to the DAIN normalization layer when the total input dimension is 40. Adjust slice indices or compute dynamic splits based on input_dim to ensure DAIN receives the expected 26 features instead of 14, resolving the dimension mismatch crash during training.
acceptance_criteria: CausalLOBForecaster can be instantiated with input_dim=40 without errors.
Forward pass with a random tensor of shape (batch, seq_len, 40) completes without dimension mismatch errors.
During forward pass, the input tensor to DAIN normalization has exactly 26 feature dimensions as verified by shape checks.
user_stories.verification: python -c "import torch; from src.models.causal_lob_forecaster import CausalLOBForecaster; model = CausalLOBForecaster(input_dim=40); x = torch.randn(2, 10, 40); out = model(x); assert out is not None, 'Forward pass failed'; print('Forward pass successful')"

user_stories.title: Add unit test for CausalLOBForecaster dimension handling and causality
user_stories.description: Extend the existing test file tests/test_causal_lob_forecaster.py with a new test that verifies the model correctly handles input dimensions and maintains causality. This test will use random tensors to check input-output shapes and ensure no future leakage, preventing regression of dimension-related issues.
acceptance_criteria: New test function test_causal_lob_forecaster_dimensions passes when run with pytest.
Test asserts that model output shape is correct for a given input shape (e.g., (batch, seq_len, input_dim)).
Test includes a causality check, such as verifying that predictions do not depend on future time steps via masking or gradient analysis.
